locations.title: 18 - GrainT Barley
locations.description:
Reward for solving the box puzzle in this area.

- Push a small box onto a pressure pad next to the left display to release a [Rope](#loc=463718)
- Climb it, jump through a hole, and pull the [Lever](#loc=463719)
- Push all three small boxes onto the large pressure pad on the left so the displays read '23 03'
- Open the crate and take the can!
